NEW v10 (migration 034). A row means the op was PERMITTED, not that it ran (PreToolUse). Recording is gated on the hatch actually averting a block — a harmless hatched command records nothing. `value` is USER-SUPPLIED FREE TEXT when CAST_HATCH_REASON is set (sanitized, <=500 chars); never render it as evidence of what executed. has_reason=0 iff value is a bare 1/true/yes. Capped at 8 records per command; overflow emits ONE sentinel row with variable='CAST_HATCH_RECORD_CAP' — exclude it from hatch counts. created_at is SQLite space format ('YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'), not ISO-T/Z. Reader: cast-ask-index.py:330 (kind='hatch').

NEW v10 (migration 032). Pre-prune rollup of agent_runs, PK (day,agent,model,status). Per-run average is SUM(cost_usd)/SUM(runs) — NEVER AVG(cost_usd), the rows are already aggregated. NEVER UNION with raw agent_runs: the rollup already covers every day including unpruned recent ones, so a union double-counts. Today's row is PARTIAL until the ~03:30 run (check rolled_up_at). Never pruned, so it outlives the 90-day agent_runs window.

NEW v10 (migration 032). Rolled up from routing_events WHERE event_type='mcp_tool_call' AND json_valid(data). is_cloud_bound resolves via config/egress-policy.json. Same rollup rules as agent_runs_daily. Never pruned.

_status_vocabulary.live: a writer exists and runs on the stated cadence; writers are line-validated by scripts/cast-producer-contract-check.py
_status_vocabulary.dormant: table and writer both exist, but the writer is gated off (feature disabled, credentials absent). Zero rows is CORRECT — surface a 'dormant' badge, never an error state.
_status_vocabulary.external: written by something outside this repo
_status_vocabulary.dead_writer_retired: the writer was removed; historical rows remain and are still valid. Show the data with a 'no longer updated' badge.
_status_vocabulary.retired: the TABLE itself no longer exists in the canonical schema or on live DBs. Consumers MUST NOT query it — a graceful table-exists probe turns this into a permanently empty panel that looks like 'nothing happened'.
